Comparison

ChatGPT vs Claude

A side-by-side look at ChatGPT and Claude, using the details in each tool profile.

Quick take

Choose ChatGPT when your priority is: broad daily knowledge work where one assistant must cover writing, analysis and code. Choose Claude when your priority is: long-document analysis, careful professional writing, and agentic coding across a whole codebase.

Pricing notes

ChatGPT

Free $0 (ad-supported since the 2026 ad rollout). Go $8/mo. Plus $20/mo. Pro sold as two usage tiers: $100/mo (5x Plus usage) and $200/mo (20x Plus usage, priority compute, ~250 Deep Research tasks). Business $20/seat/mo annual or $25/seat/mo monthly (2-seat minimum; cut from $25/$30 in April 2026); a Premium seat runs roughly $100-125. Enterprise custom, annual contract. API billed per token, separate bill.

Claude

Free $0. Pro $20/mo or $200/yr (~$17/mo effective). Max in two tiers: $100/mo (5x Pro) and $200/mo (20x Pro). Team from $25/seat/mo (about $20/seat annual) for standard seats, with a higher premium seat tier. Enterprise custom. Education plans for institutions. API separate: Fable 5.1 $10/$50 per 1M in/out tokens, Opus 5 $5/$25, Sonnet 5 $2/$10, Haiku 4.5 $1/$5.

Prices change often. Confirm on the official pricing pages: ChatGPT ↗ · Claude ↗

Frequently asked questions

What is the main difference between ChatGPT and Claude?

ChatGPT: General-purpose conversational assistant built on OpenAI's GPT model family. Claude: Conversational assistant from Anthropic focused on long-context reasoning, careful writing, document analysis and agentic coding.

When should I choose ChatGPT over Claude?

ChatGPT is listed as best for: broad daily knowledge work where one assistant must cover writing, analysis and code. Claude is listed as best for: long-document analysis, careful professional writing, and agentic coding across a whole codebase.

Do ChatGPT and Claude have a free plan?

ChatGPT: Yes. Claude: Yes. Check each official pricing page, as plans change.
